display.purpose: Page title only (leonimust.com, projects, games, apps) — bold, browser-default 2em.

body.purpose: Default for nearly everything: paragraphs, nav links, project labels.

label.purpose: Small state text: status lines, WIP tag, volume readout.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Project card on hover only, paired with a -8px lift.

shadows.name: floating-panel
shadows.purpose: Overlays that float above content at rest: volume popover, modals.

motion.name: ease-hover
motion.purpose: Default color/border/background transition on hover states.

motion.name: ease-lift
motion.purpose: Card lift + shadow transition on hover.

motion.name: pulse-down
motion.purpose: The only self-animating color: a down-status indicator pulsing for attention.

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: A navigation link styled as a quiet chip; brightens and underlines on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-block; position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 9px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; color: #444444; font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-item::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 0; height: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); transition: width 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #ffffff; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-nav-item:hover::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: The primary content unit for projects, games, and apps — flat at rest, lifts and gains a diagonal sheen on hover.
components.html:
spoticraft

spotify in minecraft
components.css: .ds-project-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: 260px; padding: 22px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease; } .ds-project-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 0%, transparent 60%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.35s ease; } .ds-project-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-project-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-project-card-img { height: 140px; width: 100%; object-fit: contain; margin-bottom: 12px; filter: grayscale(15%); transition: filter 0.35s ease, transform 0.35s ease; } .ds-project-card:hover .ds-project-card-img { filter: grayscale(0%) brightness(1.08); transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-project-card-title, .ds-project-card-desc { position: relative; z-index: 1; text-align: center; color: #444444; font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-project-card:hover .ds-project-card-title, .ds-project-card:hover .ds-project-card-desc { color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Status Indicator
components.description: Live up/down state pulled from a real network check; down pulses for attention.
components.html:
supercold is up

doom is down
components.css: .ds-status { font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; font-size: 0.82em; opacity: 0.75; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-status-up { color: #4caf50; text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(76,175,80,0.4); } .ds-status-down { color: #ff5555; animation: ds-pulse-red 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse-red { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.6; } }

components.name: WIP Badge
components.description: Dashed-border card variant marking unfinished work, with a corner tag and a blinking terminal cursor in the copy.
components.html:
package tracker

track all your packages in one app
components.css: .ds-wip-card { border: 1px dashed rgba(184,150,62,0.35); } .ds-wip-card:hover { border-color: rgba(184,150,62,0.6); } .ds-wip-card::after { content: '[ wip ]'; position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 12px; font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; font-size: 0.68em; color: #b8963e; opacity: 0.7; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-wip-cursor::after { content: '_'; color: #b8963e; opacity: 0.8; animation: ds-blink-cursor 1.1s step-end infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink-cursor { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.8; } 50% { opacity: 0; } }

components.name: Modal
components.description: Overlay dialog (WIP notice, dApp Store explainer) — the system's one permanently-shadowed surface.
components.html:
work in progress

this project isn't accessible yet. it's currently being built and will be available soon.
components.css: .ds-modal { background: #111111; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 10px; padding: 28px 32px; max-width: 360px; width: 90%; text-align: center; font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-modal-title { color: #ffffff; margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-modal-body { margin: 0 0 20px; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #888888; } .ds-modal-close { background: none; border: 1px solid #333333; color: #aaaaaa; font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 7px 20px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-modal-close:hover { border-color: #ffffff; color: #ffffff; } .ds-modal-close:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ring Cursor
components.description: Custom cursor replacing the system pointer above 768px: soft-follows the mouse, expands over interactive elements, shrinks on click.
components.css: .ds-dynamic-cursor { position: fixed; width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transition: width 0.2s ease, height 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-dynamic-cursor.hover { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-dynamic-cursor.click { width: 16px; height: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

narrative.overview:
Almost the entire interface sits just above invisible: a near-black void, dim gray type, borders you can barely see. Nothing decorative is allowed to compete for attention — so when something does light up (white on hover, a green "up" pulse, a red "down" flicker, the amber WIP tag), it reads as a signal, not styling. The site opens on a loading gate and autoplay music before any content exists, so the first thing a visitor does is tune in rather than land on a page. Everything after that — the randomized entrance animation, the drifting background code symbols, the ring cursor that only fills in on hover — keeps that same posture: quiet by default, alive on contact.

This is explicitly not a corporate SaaS portfolio. No gradients, no card shadows at rest, no rounded pill buttons, no trust-badge polish. It is a terminal that happens to render a portfolio, built by one person with a dry, self-aware sense of humor ("i could pwned you but would i?", "catjpg still watching").
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome-first: color exists only as functional signal, never as decoration
Flat at rest, alive on interaction: shadow, lift, and brightness are all earned by hover
Hierarchy through color/opacity (dim → bright), not through font-size — most type sits at browser-default sizes
Entry is a ritual (loading → music gate → randomized entrance), not a landing

rules.name: The Grayscale-First Rule
rules.body: Color is reserved for state, never decoration. The only hues that exist outside black/white/gray are functional: Status Up green, Status Down red, WIP Amber, and the single dApp-Store Teal. If a new element wants color and isn't communicating state, it doesn't get one.

rules.name: The No-Scale-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Reach for color/opacity before font-size. Dim gray → bright white communicates "primary vs. secondary" more than the type scale does; the scale itself barely moves (three real steps: label, body, display).

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Touched Rule
rules.body: Static content never carries a shadow. If something has depth at rest, it had better be an overlay (modal, floating panel) — not a card, section, or button sitting in the normal flow.

dos: Do keep new UI grayscale by default; earn any color by tying it to a real state (up/down, WIP, a named external brand).
Do let hover be where the site "wakes up" — brightness, lift, and shadow are interaction rewards, not resting decoration.
Do keep the one monospace face for everything; don't introduce a second font for "emphasis."
Do keep status indicators (/games) and store badges (/mobile) wired to real state — they are proof-of-life, not copy.
Do stagger multi-item entrances (nav, cards) rather than having them appear all at once.
donts: Don't add gradients, drop shadows at rest, rounded pill buttons, or any "trust us" SaaS polish — that's the explicit anti-reference.
Don't give any element a resting shadow unless it's a genuine overlay (modal, floating panel).
Don't reach for font-size to build hierarchy before reaching for color/opacity.
Don't reuse dApp-Store Teal outside the Solana Mobile citation, or WIP Amber outside marking unfinished work — both are single-purpose signal colors, not a starter palette.
Don't fabricate uptime, availability, or store-badge state — if it isn't live-checked or real, it doesn't ship as if it were.
